text:
emma: Opening a follow-up thread for the vendor/dependency outage PM. Goal: capture owners, short-term mitigations, and medium-term contractual actions. Reply with ack + which item you take.

raj: Ack. Can we list discrete actions so they fit into INC-2026-419?

emma: Yep. Short list I extracted from the PM: 1) emergency fallback blobstore for artifacts when primary cloud S3 fails; 2) model-registry auth graceful-degradation and cached manifests; 3) provider-side escalation + backup contact card; 4) monthly recurrence review and dashboard; 5) automated post-deploy smoke that includes auth + registry.

hao: I'll pick the cached manifests piece for model-registry. Proposal: store last-known model-manifest in redis with strong consistency TTL 10m and fall back to cached model metadata for up to 90s during registry outage. ETA: feature branch by Tue 2026-03-31.

emma: @hao assign. Add an acceptance test that simulates registry timeouts.

hao: Will add.


taylor: I'll take the emergency fallback blobstore flow. Plan: write a small one-off lambda that pulls artifacts to a read-only backup bucket in a different cloud provider every 12h, and add a manual failover document. ETA: 2026-04-08.

emma: @taylor include a quick rollback plan in the doc and the command to enable failover.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-419 and linked jira: https://jira.internal/browse/INC-2026-419

vendor-eng: About escalation: we currently only have the regional sysadmin alias. I will add a 24/7 on-call manager contact for provider-A and request a faster engagement SLA. Expect update by Mon COB 2026-03-23.

raj: For contractual relief, legal wants language for repeated incidents: recommend drafting an "availability credits" clause and an incident review cadence. @product-ops can you liaise?

product-ops: Happy to. I'll draft suggested language and share with legal and vendor-eng by next week.

emma: Recurrence tracking: we've had similar auth/registry outages ~ 4 times in last 120 days. We should add a monthly dashboard showing counts by root-cause and by vendor. Who can own?

raj: I can own the dashboard. I'll add a Grafana panel and a small query to populate the postmortem board. ETA: 2026-04-01.

hao: Small ops pattern: when registry auth fails, reduce token refresh QPS by batching refresh attempts (single-flight) and add a per-node jitter to avoid stampeding. I'll implement single-flight in the client lib. ETA: 2026-03-28.


taylor: For post-deploy smoke: let's add a smoke job that runs 5 real-ish requests against registry and auth with a canary token. If any fail or exceed 450ms, block the rollout. I'll coordinate with infra. ETA: 2026-04-05.

emma: Good. Make the smoke optional for hotfixes but required for minor releases. Add doc to release playbook.

vendor-eng: Also recommend we start a joint RCA cadence with provider-A every quarter for the next 12 months, until we see sustained stability. I'll propose schedule and invite list.

raj: For telemetry, emit structured events when we switch to fallback blobstore or serve cached model: fields: event_type, triggered_by, duration_ms, affected_route, fallback_action, owner_team. Keep schema minimal.

hao: I'll add a small logging helper in client-lib to emit these events.

product-ops: Legal asked to capture incident impact numbers in the PM board (users affected, QPS impacted, revenue estimate). Can we standardize the table in the monthly report?

emma: Yes. I'll add a template row: incident_ts, root_cause, affected_services, duration, customers_impacted_est, mitigation_taken, owner. Raj + product-ops will populate.

raj: Quick risk note: fallback blobstore introduces eventual consistency risk for new artifacts. We'll need a short TTL and a verification job that reconciles artifacts after failover. I'll add a reconciliation task to INC-2026-419.


taylor: Noted. I'll include a reconciliation script and a runbook step to run it after failover.

emma: Owners recap: hao (cached manifests + single-flight token changes) -> 2026-03-28 / 2026-03-31; taylor (fallback blobstore + reconciliation) -> 2026-04-08; raj (dashboard + telemetry) -> 2026-04-01; product-ops (contract wording liaison) -> 2026-03-30; vendor-eng (escalation contacts + SLA ask) -> 2026-03-23.

ops-bot: Reminder: recurring incident-pattern review scheduled on 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC. Meeting created: https://meet.internal/incident-review

emma: I'll check progress next week. Please drop PR or ticket links in INC-2026-419 and react with :white_check_mark: when done.

vendor-eng: Added contact card to INC-2026-419 and pinged provider-A for SLA meeting.

hao: Draft PR for cached-manifest branch pushed: https://git.internal/p/cached-manifest-wip

raj: Dashboard panel created in staging. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/incident-patterns

product-ops: Draft contract clause in docs: https://confluence.internal/display/OPS/Vendor+Credits+Draft (WIP)

emma: Thanks all. Closing thread - will surface progress in the weekly on-call sync. If any ETA slips, update INC-2026-419 immediately. :thumbsup:
